Initial bottom: green, purple, blue, yellow
After using blue: green, purple, yellow (blue consumed)
After using green: purple, yellow (green consumed)
After using yellow: purple (yellow consumed)

- Dot 3: [29,34]-[30,35], center (29, 34)
- Dot 4: [29,40]-[30,41], center (29, 40)
Plan:

2. Click green (58, 19) → click dot 2 (29, 28)

4. Click purple (58, 27) → click dot 4 (29, 40)
